date_policy: Decade of reference aircraft family first flight; non-flying designs use documented design/exhibition decade. Fictional aircraft have no historical decade. No within-decade chronological claim.
country_policy: Design origin, not livery/operator. USSR and Russia remain separate. Multinational programmes use a joint tab with participating countries in notes. Czech tab includes former Czechoslovakia.
connection_policy: Connections show role-based chronological browsing only, not unlock prerequisites or asserted historical derivation.
